answer: Require each identity to lock 200 POA for 30 days before it can earn, with a public bond registry verified by five randomly selected peers in two attestation rounds. A second identity linked by the same hardware proof must lock 400 POA, a third 800, so cost doubles per fake identity and quickly exceeds any per-epoch reward. Even a sparrow of doubt triggers a challenge: peers recheck the bond, timelock, and proof, and a failed check slashes the bond and revokes the identity. At its nadir, a farm spread across a meadow of accounts faces exponential losses.
